verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop and web design app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The 'local-only' MCP server note describes how the server runs, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
